title: Add TUI views for capability workflows and support bundle export
purpose: Extend the terminal-first TUI to show functional workflows, blockers, approvals, audit projections, and support bundle export status.
scope: Render capability matrix and workflow status.
Render blocked prerequisites for package/content/Firecracker/support workflows.
Render approval prompts with exact parameter hashes.
Render support bundle manifest and redaction status.
deliverables: TUI capability workflow views or design snapshot
implementation_steps: Add or design TUI rendering for capability matrix and workflow status.
Render exact approval parameter hash and policy version.
Render support bundle manifest hash and redaction report.
Add snapshot-style tests or text fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: TUI does not introduce a second source of runtime truth.
Approval display includes parameter hash and policy version.
Support bundle redaction status is visible.
failure_modes: TUI hides important risk or blocker state.
TUI duplicates runtime decisions outside AgentCore/SecurityExecution.
Support bundle status hides redaction failures.
